verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents claiming multiple sandboxes from a snapshot ID for parallel tasks, which is a first-party capability for running sandboxes concurrently. It also notes that resume depends on available capacity, but the pack never states actual concurrency limits or quotas, nor any evidence of large-fleet scale. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas per team or plan, evidence of large-scale fleet operation, fleet-management tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
